head_commit.message:
fix(runtime): retain transitive pins in isolated model builds

The production model skips the owner package wrapper when importing its
authenticated catalog. Preserve canonical transitive package pinning and
run all-dependency NuGet auditing at low severity in that real command.

Exercise source and package builds with a real two-version dependency
graph; the compiled model must execute the API from the central pin.

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): isolate tooling probes from PowerShell assemblies

Run catalog, embedded-schema and Aspire-path reflection in a .NET 11
file-based app. Standalone PowerShell bundles framework assemblies that
cannot be rehosted safely on .NET 11, unlike the local framework tool.

Preserve every catalog assertion and packaged-loader check, with the
existing analyzers and warnings-as-errors applied to the new probe.

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): isolate manual runs and harden submodule discovery

Give manual dispatches their own concurrency group so they never cancel
the push run that release consumes. Read root .gitmodules and gitlink
entries as NUL-separated records, so submodule names containing spaces
parse correctly, and require the exact gitlink path rather than a
directory holding one. Document that preparation detaches listed
submodules at their recorded commits.

Cover the composite phase sequence, workflow environment context,
excluded classification, duplicate declared paths, escaping runner
configurations and captured discovery output with behavioral tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
